description: Source code defining operations for etcd client v3, including operation types, methods for creating and manipulating get, put, delete, transaction, watch, and lease operations, with detailed options and internal logic.

classes.name: Op
classes.description: Represents an operation that can be executed on the key-value store, supporting get, put, delete, transaction, and watch operations with various options.

classes.name: LeaseOp
classes.description: Represents a lease operation, including attaching keys for TTL management.

methods.name: IsTxn
methods.description: Returns true if the operation is a transaction.

methods.name: Txn
methods.description: Returns the comparison, then-operations, and else-operations for a transaction.

methods.name: KeyBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice of the operation's key.

methods.name: WithKeyBytes
methods.description: Sets the byte slice of the operation's key.

methods.name: RangeBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice of the operation's range end.

methods.name: Rev
methods.description: Returns the requested revision.

methods.name: Limit
methods.description: Returns the limit of results.

methods.name: IsPut
methods.description: Returns true if the operation is a put.

methods.name: IsGet
methods.description: Returns true if the operation is a get.

methods.name: IsDelete
methods.description: Returns true if the operation is a delete.

methods.name: IsSerializable
methods.description: Returns true if the operation is serializable.

methods.name: IsKeysOnly
methods.description: Returns true if only keys are requested.

methods.name: IsCountOnly
methods.description: Returns true if only the count of keys is requested.

methods.name: MinModRev
methods.description: Returns the minimum modification revision filter.

methods.name: MaxModRev
methods.description: Returns the maximum modification revision filter.

methods.name: MinCreateRev
methods.description: Returns the minimum creation revision filter.

methods.name: MaxCreateRev
methods.description: Returns the maximum creation revision filter.

methods.name: toRangeRequest
methods.description: Converts the operation to a protobuf RangeRequest.

methods.name: toTxnRequest
methods.description: Converts the operation to a protobuf TxnRequest.

methods.name: toRequestOp
methods.description: Converts the operation to a protobuf RequestOp.

methods.name: isWrite
methods.description: Determines if the operation is a write operation.

methods.name: applyOpts
methods.description: Applies a list of options to configure the operation.

methods.name: OpGet
methods.description: Creates a get operation with specified key and options.

methods.name: OpDelete
methods.description: Creates a delete operation with specified key and options.

methods.name: OpPut
methods.description: Creates a put operation with specified key, value, and options.

methods.name: OpTxn
methods.description: Creates a transaction operation with comparison, then, and else operations.

methods.name: opWatch
methods.description: Creates a watch operation with specified key and options.

methods.name: toLeaseTimeToLiveRequest
methods.description: Creates a LeaseTimeToLiveRequest protobuf message.

methods.name: IsOptsWithPrefix
methods.description: Checks if WithPrefix option is set in the options.

methods.name: IsOptsWithFromKey
methods.description: Checks if WithFromKey option is set in the options.

methods.name: IsSortOptionValid
methods.description: Validates the sort options of an operation.
